text:
Priya Patel: CoralBank just opened a P1 — dedicated pool returning intermittent 503s since 03:10 UTC. Customer SLA flagged for today. Can we get ownership and a short mitigation plan?
eng-oncall-bot: Alert created: #INC-2026-447 (CoralBank dedicated 503 surge). Pager duty notified.
Jordan Lee: Seen the alert, looking at metrics now. Any recent deploys to pool-corala?
Priya Patel: No deploys from our side in the last 6h. Customer says traffic spike ~03:05, then errors started. P99 for generation jumped to 1.8s, error rate ~2.3%.
Sam Ortiz: I'll take first ownership for triage. Starting with rate/queue backpressure and pod restarts. Can someone share the live tail of the runtime logs?
Luis Gomez: Pulling logs — attaching last 200 lines from runtime node-7: ```
[03:07:22] warn kv-cache-miss seq=1 key=...
[03:07:45] error upstream-timeout model-infer id=0x9f33
[03:08:03] info batch-scheduler backpressure=high pending=42
[03:08:59] error 503 http request-id=abcd-1234
```
Jordan Lee: Looks like continuous batching backlog spiked. Batching window expanded to try to absorb burst, causing upstream timeouts. Suggest temporarily lowering max_batch_wait_ms for pool-corala and enabling immediate fallback to hosted small-llm for CoralBank route.
Priya Patel: Customer on a tight window — they want a mitigation within 30m or they'll fail their end-of-day processing. Can we coordinate config change + a short rollback plan?
Sam Ortiz: Plan: 1) set max_batch_wait_ms=8 -> reduces latency at cost of throughput 2) if errors persist, route 10% traffic to hosted-small model variant 3) if still bad, scale up pool by +2 gpus (request to infra). I'll execute step 1 now and monitor.
Luis Gomez: Applying runtime flag to pool-corala now. Patch: `redwoodctl set-pool-config pool-corala --max_batch_wait_ms=8`
eng-oncall-bot: Change applied by Luis Gomez at 03:18 UTC.
Jordan Lee: Monitoring dashboards — pending queue dropped from 42 -> 6 in ~30s, error rate down to 0.6%. Latency p99 down to 850ms. Good signal.
Priya Patel: Nice. Sam, please keep watch for 20m and then decide whether to roll 10% to hosted. Ping me before routing change.
Sam Ortiz: Will do. Also opened infra request #INF-2026-78 to add +2 gpus if we need sustained capacity.
Luis Gomez: Noted — I'll prep a canary route config for 10% hosted fallback. Script: `routes apply coralbank --canary=hosted-small:10%` ready if needed.
Priya Patel: Thanks team. I'll update the customer that we applied a config tweak and are monitoring; will confirm next steps in 20m.
Jordan Lee: Quick async Q: For postmortem, we should track: traffic pattern that triggered batching, why autoscale didn't add capacity, and whether per-customer caps would have helped.
Sam Ortiz: Agreed. I'll keep ownership until we hit stable state, then hand to eng-platform for postmortem write-up.
Priya Patel: Ownership acked. If error rate creeps back above 1.5% escalate to oncall senior.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: @Sam Ortiz in 20 minutes to check stability and update thread.
Priya Patel: Thx everyone :thumbsup:
